# Job Tracking Helper

> A job search app. It finds open roles that fit what you asked for, gets each application ready, and keeps track of what you sent. It never presses Submit: you check the form and send it yourself.

Job Tracking Helper is a web app at https://ye.saranatour.dev. Everything past the public pages below needs an account, so please don't crawl it.

What it does:

- Searches the public job feeds of companies on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Personio, SmartRecruiters and Workable, plus Remote OK, Hacker News and the German Arbeitsagentur.
- Judges each role against your stated preferences and shortlists the ones that fit.
- Reads a posting's form, matches your saved answers and drafts job-specific ones for you to check.
- Tracks applications on a board or list, with status history, notes and related email.
- Handles mail through your own Cloudflare account, plus a calendar.

What it doesn't do:

- Send an application for you.
- Answer demographic questions on purpose, or store job-site passwords.
- Guarantee interviews or job offers.

## For agents

- [Job search with no account](https://ye.saranatour.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/job-search-no-account/SKILL.md): a skill that finds roles on the public feeds, drafts answers and tracks them in local files, with no sign-up
- [Job goals with no account](https://ye.saranatour.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/job-goals-no-account/SKILL.md): a skill for any AI chat that sets goals and preferences and can keep a decision and report on each company, with no sign-up or API key
- [auth.md](https://ye.saranatour.dev/auth.md): how to connect to the MCP server for someone with an account
- [API catalog](https://ye.saranatour.dev/.well-known/api-catalog): where the API and its description are

## Pages

- [Home](https://ye.saranatour.dev/): what the app is and how to get started
- [Jobs](https://ye.saranatour.dev/jobs): open roles from company job boards, to search and link to
- [Privacy Policy](https://ye.saranatour.dev/privacy): what data the app handles and who it goes to
- [Terms of Use](https://ye.saranatour.dev/terms): the rules for using the app
